title: Management Information Systems: Main Exam, 28 August 2019
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Transaction processing systems are essential enterprise systems at the lower level of management. Describe the limitations of transaction processing systems.
State the 4 basic functional areas in a business organization that can leverage modern information systems, and indicate the relevant business process.

As digital technologies evolve, business organizations and individuals are also experiencing exponential opportunities. Examine the relevance of information systems in the modern world that is characterized by the convergence of the Internet and digital technology.

As a systems manager and cyber-security expert in the service industry, explain 3 key techniques for protecting organizational data from virus attacks within the context of web and mobile-based systems.

As society and organizations embrace information technologies, new social and ethical issues continue to emerge. Evaluate the manifestation and implications of intellectual property rights as a critical ethical issue in the context of modern technologies.
Evaluate the benefits of management information systems within the context of multinational business firms.
Examine the factors that would guide an organization in deciding whether to re-engineer an existing system or to develop an entirely new information system.
Explain five key components of information technology infrastructure and provide relevant examples.
With special reference to developing countries like Kenya, evaluate the challenges that characterize managing IT infrastructure.

One of the key reasons for the rising interest in information technology by business organizations today is to promote the achievement of strategic objectives. Relate the application of information systems to strategic business objectives.
Examine the benefits and limitations of decision support systems and clarify the levels of management they support.
Assuming you are a policy analyst in ICT, analyse the ways in which web-based information systems are influencing business firms and organizations in the 21st century.

In today's modern society, organizations have continued to recognize employees as a key concern in information systems security management. Explain various methods and technologies that can be applied to protect against internal security threats for information systems.
